evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫 (Multi-function Chinese Character Database)
evidence.field: 形義通解; 《玉篇》/《廣韻》 data; example citations
evidence.text: The database analyzes 呢 as 口 semantic + 尼 phonetic, and gives its grammatical-particle use for questions. It quotes late-imperial examples: question-final usage in 儒林外史 and affirmative sentence-final usage in 紅樓夢. It also lists a separate noun sense for woollen cloth. These entries establish recorded uses, but do not date the first appearance of the cloth sense.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 - 字頭「呢」

evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.field: 研訂瀏覽; 玉篇 and 集韻 citations
evidence.text: The entry reports 玉篇's reading 女知切 and gloss 呢喃小聲多言也 (“soft, low, much speech”), and cites 集韻 for an alternative graph replacing 尼 with 貳. This supports a medieval lexicographic record for the graph and a nonchronological graphic variant; the entry's searchable shape-history tables do not expose early oracle or bronze forms for 呢.
evidence.title: A00558 呢 - 教育部《異體字字典》

evidence.source: Chen, Current Research in Chinese Linguistics 101(2) (2022)
evidence.text: The study distinguishes particle functions and spellings. It reports a Southern Song vernacular-story example of 呢 as a topic-question marker, potentially a transcription of 尼. Yuan 老乞大新釋 has a sample of 呢 predominantly as an interrogative-strengthening particle, also in non-interrogative final and topic-related uses. The study's comparative table tracks earlier spellings including 爾, 聻, 尼, 哩, and 裏 across texts. These are histories of spoken particles and their spellings, not proof that the graph 呢 itself originated from any one particle.
evidence.title: Current Research in Chinese Linguistics, 101(2), article on the historical sources/functions of 呢 particles

evidence.source: Hong, Current Research in Chinese Linguistics 101(2) (2022)
evidence.text: Summarizes competing accounts: Lü Shuxiang derives both forms through 哩 as a variant writing of 裏, linked to 在裏; Ota distinguishes interrogative 呢 from non-interrogative 呢, deriving the former through 爾/聻 and the latter through sentence-final locative 裏; Jiang Lansheng combines aspects of these histories, while Sun Xixin follows Ota. The article presents these as scholarly proposals rather than settled derivations. It also notes that the competing histories remain disputed.
evidence.title: Current Research in Chinese Linguistics, 101(2), article on grammaticalization and 呢

evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫 (Multi-function Chinese Character Database)
evidence.field: 普通話; 《廣韻》; 形義通解
evidence.text: For 呢 the database gives Mandarin ne and 女夷切, classified in Middle Chinese as 娘母, level tone, 止攝脂韻, open, division III. It independently analyzes 尼 as the phonetic component. The phonological classification is evidence for the dictionary's reading tradition, not by itself proof of the historical phonetic relationship.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 - 字頭「呢」

evidence.field: Middle Chinese and Old Chinese readings for 尼
evidence.text: For 尼 it reports fanqie 女夷切 and Middle Chinese 娘母, 脂韻, level tone, division III. It lists Baxter–Sagart Old Chinese readings *nˤərʔ, *nˤərʔ-s, and *nr[əj] for distinct lexemes, and Zhengzhang Old Chinese *nil. The systems and reading variants must remain separate: the *nil comparison is Zhengzhang, not Baxter–Sagart. The local dossier only supplied Unihan kMandarin ne for 呢; the exact 尼 local reading row and local Baxter–Sagart rows were not provided in the inputs.

search_audit.outcome: Inspected scholarly articles discussing competing particle-source analyses and attestation samples, plus a secondary reading table. No adequate primary or specialist source located for the cloth word's origin or first attestation.

gaps: The early graphic history of 呢 is unresolved: the MOE character-variant page lists historical reference collections but reports no accessible early oracle/bronze forms for this graph; no inspected source establishes its original glyph or any graphic corruption.

The phonetic analysis 口 + 尼 is supported by the CUHK character database, but the historical sound comparison is not established here from matching local Baxter–Sagart rows. Available secondary data distinguishes 呢's dossier Zhengzhang *nil from 尼's Baxter–Sagart readings; these notations must not be conflated.

The local Baxter–Sagart TSV was not accessible through this research interface, and no official upstream table page with exact rows was inspected. No claim is made that 呢 has a Baxter–Sagart *nil reading.
Current kMandarin official Unihan records for 呢 and 尼 could not be opened. The provided local 呢 row is ne; no local 尼 row was supplied. Unicode click-through verification remains outstanding.

Particle-source analyses conflict: the sources report proposals involving 爾/聻/尼 for interrogative uses and 裏/哩 for non-interrogative uses, while other researchers group developments differently. Direct derivational links and the earliest attestations of all proposed source forms were not fully checked.

No independent source was found here for the actual pronunciation/name of a depicted object that could ground a whole-graph phonetic loan. The discussion concerns grammatical particles and the compound's phonetic component, not a demonstrated depicted tool/object loan.

The dossier's substrate-word proposal for Cantonese 呢 (“this”), its comparison forms, and the English-level clipping proposal were not verified. Keep these distinct from graphic history and the Mandarin particle.
The woollen-cloth sense is attested in the CUHK database, but its date, source language, and relationship (if any) to the particle graph remain undetermined.
No source established a Japanese-created origin for 呢; the supplied Japanese reading data does not establish a Japanese origin.
